captions.detailed: An airfield-scale advertising blimp featuring a large, grey, cigar-shaped envelope with orange-yellow side banners. An underslung white gondola with blue accents sits below the envelope, supported by a small wheeled landing gear. Twin engine nacelles with rotating propellers are mounted on the sides of the envelope, and a cruciform tail assembly is fitted at the rear with movable red control surfaces.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an advertising blimp with a grey cigar-shaped envelope, side banners, an underslung gondola with landing wheels, twin side-mounted engine nacelles with spinning propellers, and a cruciform tail assembly with functional rudders and elevators.
captions.factory: The blimp is constructed by modeling the main envelope as an elongated ellipsoid (using a scaled sphere or revolved profile). The gondola is built from a box primitive with subtracted window slots, attached below the envelope. Side engine nacelles are modeled as cylinders with revolving propellers attached via continuous joints. The cruciform tail fins are constructed from thin boxes, with the rudder and elevators connected via revolute joints on their respective hinge axes. The landing gear under the gondola is assembled from cylinder struts and wheel cylinders with continuous rotation joints.
